died.name: Pierre de Bocosel de Chastelard
died.cause: addressing the window of Holyrood Palace before being hanged for hiding under the bed of Mary, Queen of Scots
died.last_words: Farewell, thou who art so beautiful and so cruel; who killest me and whom I cannot cease to love.

died.name: Michael Malloy
died.cause: Five people, called the "Murder Trust," planned to kill Malloy for life insurance. Over the course of two months, they added antifreeze, turpentine, horse liniment, and finally rat poison in his alcohol, but Malloy drank it with no problems whatsoever. They then tried feeding him wood alcohol, expired oysters, and then a sandwich made of expired sardines and shrapnel, none of which had the desired effect. The group then tried to freeze him to death, and when that failed they ran him over twice with a taxi, from which Malloy recovered. Finally, they connected a hose to a coal gas jet and placed it in his mouth, which caused his death from carbon monoxide poisoning. Malloy was given nicknames such as "Mike the Durable", "Iron Mike", and "The Irish Rasputin".

died.name: Stefan Zweig
died.cause: in his last testament before committing suicide with his wife, Lotte Altmann
died.last_words: I think it better to conclude in good time and in erect bearing a life in which intellectual labour meant the purest joy and personal freedom the highest good on Earth.

died.name: Sophie Scholl
died.desc: member of White Rose anti-Nazi resistance movement, sister of Hans Scholl
died.cause: before she was taken for beheading by guillotine
died.last_words: How can we expect righteousness to prevail when there is hardly anyone willing to give himself up individually to a righteous cause... It is such a splendid sunny day, and I have to go. But how many have to die on the battlefield in these days, how many young, promising lives. What does my death matter if by our acts thousands are warned and alerted. Among the student body there will certainly be a revolt.

died.name: Hans Scholl
died.desc: co-founder of White Rose resistance movement
died.cause: a moment before he was beheaded by guillotine

died.name: David Ferrie
died.cause: in apparent suicide note (alluding to Galatians 6:7). Ferrie's autopsy concluded that he had died of natural causes
died.last_words: To leave this life, to me, is a sweet prospect. When you read this I will be quite dead and no answer will be possible. All I can say is that I offered you love, and the best I could. All I got in return in the end was a kick in the teeth. Thus I die alone and unloved. As you sowed, so shall you reap.

born.name: George Washington
born.cause: to Dr. James Craik and his personal secretary, Tobias Lear
born.last_words: I die hard, but I am not afraid to go... I am just going. Have me decently buried, and do not let my body be put into the vault in less than two days after I am dead. Do you understand me? 'Tis well.

born.name: Duchess Sophie Charlotte in Bavaria
born.cause: killed in Bazar de la Charité fire in Paris
born.last_words: In a few minutes, think that we will see God, that we will be in Heaven.

born.name: Kenneth Williams
born.cause: the last words he wrote in his diary

born.name: Romas Kalanta
born.cause: prior to committing suicide by self-immolation to protest the Soviet regime in Lithuania
born.last_words: Blame only the regime for my death.
